title: Linework: Trace & Draw
shortDescription: Use a camera overlay or lightbox to practise drawing from your own images.
fullDescription:
Trace photos and templates onto real paper with a camera overlay, or use your screen as a bright lightbox.

Choose an image, stand your phone securely above your paper, and follow the lines with your own pencil. Resize, rotate, move and fade the picture, then lock it in place while you draw. Linework shows an overlay through your phone; it does not project an image onto your paper.

MAKE IT YOURS
Import a picture using the system photo picker. Turn it into an outline on your device, adjust the line style, or trace the original image. Browse built-in templates, lettering and Workshop layouts for drawing and craft projects.

DRAW AT YOUR PACE
Use opacity, grid, mirror and touch-lock controls. Lightbox mode works without camera access: place thin paper over the screen and trace. Record a drawing clip and save it to your Photos library when you choose.

TRY PLUS FOR 14 DAYS
Start an optional 14-day trial from the Plus screen. When it ends, tracing your own photos, every tracing tool and 24 starter templates stay free. Linework Plus unlocks the full template library and photo-to-outline with a one-time purchase. No subscription or automatic charge at the end of the trial. Google Play displays your local purchase price.

No ads or app account. Image processing happens on your device. Use a stable phone stand for camera tracing.
